key_insight: The paper simplifies and strengthens the theory of measurement-based computation on prime-dimensional qudits by defining a clearer notion of flow, proving focused flow is canonical, and making flow finding faster and more usable.
engineering_relevance: This improves the design and optimization of qudit-based measurement-based quantum circuits, enabling more practical compilation, verification, and automated generation of larger deterministic computations.
method: Redefine qudit flow in a simpler form and show how to focus it.
Extend the algebraic characterization so focused flow can be found with an O(n^3) algorithm.
Study flow-preserving graph transformations such as pivoting, vertex insertion/removal, and reversibility.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a refined flow formulation and an O(n^3) flow-finding algorithm, improving on the previous O(n^4) qudit result and matching the best known qubit complexity.
watch_item: The results apply to prime-dimensional qudit graph states, so extending them beyond prime dimensions or to noisy hardware may require additional theory and validation.
paper_title: Working with measurement-based computations on qudits
